Capability: Plans desktop browser-test coverage for a change as lean, affected, full or not-applicable, runs barrier and sharded remainder stages, and aggregates stage results into one verdict.
Notes: Duration hints JSON weights shard partitioning. Unknown or shared inputs deliberately fall back to full coverage; omissions are recorded explicitly in the plan.

Capability: Runs the pull-request desktop browser-test gate: selection with policy self-test, accessibility barrier, four-shard remainder when full, and one stable aggregate check.
Notes: Also dispatchable manually with a target base for retarget proofs. Uploads plans, collections and failure reports as run artifacts.

Capability: Provisions a CI runner for desktop browser tests: pinned Node, Rust and wasm-bindgen, locked npm and Cargo fetch, wasm engine build, cached Playwright Chromium and system deps.
Notes: Composite action shared by the E2E workflow and the cache-warming workflow. Rewrites Ubuntu apt sources before installing browser system dependencies.

Capability: Warms main-branch dependency caches for the desktop browser-test setup when dependency or setup inputs change, without running tests.
Notes: Guarded to run only in the private monorepo on main; the public source projection skips it.

Capability: Runs the five-surface local evidence sweep (Rust crates, Python tests, desktop unit tests with wasm build, browser tests, production build) and writes a commit-bound validated summary.
Notes: Can consume a commit-bound record of a CI browser-test run instead of running that surface locally. Writes into archived evidence output. Preflights toolchain, Python version and offline Cargo cache.

Capability: Builds and optionally executes profile-based local release-readiness check plans, including required-document presence, Cargo crate discovery and a security profile.
Notes: Provider-neutral and local. Reused as a step by the protected-content scan and coverage tooling. Reads the latest graph edges file to feed the dependency-schema validator.

Capability: Collects opt-in Rust, Python and desktop coverage telemetry into a commit-bound schema-validated JSON record; missing tools are recorded as not measured and never fail the run.
Notes: Non-blocking by design; exit code reflects only artifact integrity. No numeric floor is enforced.

Capability: Evaluates release-quality gate criteria for solver, rule-engine, GUI, report-template and mixed families from existing sweep, scan and coverage records and writes pass/fail/TBD records.
Notes: Read-only over prior evidence; never reruns the sweep. Human-gated criteria stay TBD. Outcomes do not affect exit code.

Capability: Scans a release candidate's artifact classes for protected content, provenance-manifest defects and quarantine hygiene, and emits an unsigned per-candidate scan record.
Notes: Calls the engine protected-content lint binary. Records always carry a pending owner sign-off; a clean record is not a clearance.

Capability: Stages an allowlisted, sanitized public export of the project tree with a path/size/hash manifest, forbidden-path and content checks, protected-content lint gate, and re-hash verification.
Notes: Builds and self-tests the export mechanism only; creates no public repository and pushes nothing. Fails toward exclusion.

Capability: Packages the built macOS desktop app bundle into a deterministic zip with a SHA-256 checksum and a commit-bound release artifact record checked against sweep evidence.
Notes: Apple Silicon only; no signing, notarization, upload or tagging. Verifies the executable is arm64.

Capability: Procedurally renders the desktop application icon and writes the PNG source mark and a multi-resolution macOS icns file without host icon tooling.
Notes: Writes into apps/desktop/src-tauri/icons. Pixel output is exact; compressed bytes may vary with host zlib. Invented artwork only.

Capability: Builds the private checked canonical-JSON adapter executable with Cargo so Python tests and development can use it.
Notes: Invoked by the pytest session setup when no executable path is supplied. The runtime adapter never builds it itself and only points users here.

Capability: Validates the reference-only architecture-basis corpus against its reading contract: member set, required files, context notices, manifest hashes and pinned decomposition revision.
Notes: Operates on the governance tree rather than product code. Contains a hard-coded revision pin that must be updated by hand.

Capability: Validates a dependency register CSV against the canonical column set, enumerations and row rules, reporting VALID or INVALID with an exit code.
Notes: No direct unit test in the project; the listed test only asserts that the readiness plan invokes it. A similarly named repository-root validator has its own tests.

Capability: Lists work-item lifecycle status from local status files, optionally joined to a selected dependency graph's nodes, as a table, CSV or Markdown with a summary.
Notes: Read-only coordination reporting over the governance tree; not a product path.

Capability: Canonicalizes dependency registers, moves candidate rows to worklists, builds a successor dependency graph with waves and cycle report, and writes drift evidence.
Notes: Writes governance files in place. Hard-wired to one historical graph generation, so likely a one-shot migration tool now dormant.

Capability: Inventories dependency registers across the working tree and optionally validates each one, writing inventory CSVs and a summary JSON.
Notes: Shells out to the project dependency-schema validator. Appears tied to a past refresh exercise; no caller found.

Capability: Registers the project's coordination and validation tools with purpose, inputs, outputs and usage examples.
Notes: Covers only four tools; the CI, release, serialization and architecture-basis tools are not listed.

Capability: Declares which project checks run for which changed paths (desktop build/test, Python tests, evidence sweep, harness checks) for the repository affected-check runner.
Notes: Consumed by repository-root software-workflow tools; their tests use temporary profiles, not this file.

Capability: Defines the npm workspace for the desktop app with scripts to develop, build, build wasm, unit test and browser test it, and to regenerate the preview mechanics fixture.
Notes: The preview-generation script shells to Cargo and overwrites a committed fixture.

Capability: Pins the complete npm dependency graph for the workspace, including the browser-test framework version used for CI browser caching.
Notes: Dependency lock only. Its change forces full browser-test coverage and invalidates CI caches.

Capability: Pins the Python development dependencies used by project checks: JSON schema validation, coverage, YAML parsing and parallel pytest.
Notes: Referenced by several release tools and schema-validation helpers as the install hint.

Capability: Keeps environment secrets, private source folders, generated wasm engine outputs, build products and caches out of version control.
Notes: Mixes secret and private-source exclusion with ordinary build hygiene. Carries legacy generated-output locations for stale checkouts.

Capability: Treats captured reproduction stdout and stderr files as opaque bytes so Git never diffs, merges or normalizes line endings in checksum-governed evidence.
Notes: Applies to paths under archived evidence output only.

Capability: Provides public issue forms for bug reports, documentation feedback and questions, with blank issues disabled and a data-boundary caution.
Notes: Authored for a future public repository; dormant inside the monorepo because only the repository-root .github folder is honoured by the host.

Capability: Provides invented linear mechanics benchmark fixtures with expected values, units and provenance, compared against solver output and exposed to the headless runner's benchmark command.
Notes: Comparison values are regression evidence only; tolerance policy is recorded as unresolved. Also surfaced by the desktop validation-evidence panel.

Capability: Provides invented code-neutral stress recovery benchmark fixtures (axial, bending, torsion, pressure, range, integrated pipe) with recorded expected values run against stress recovery.
Notes: No allowables, fatigue or code-specific acceptance content. Release tolerances are recorded as unresolved.

Capability: Provides invented nonlinear support regression fixtures for one-way, gap, lift-off, friction, multi-support and non-convergence behaviour with convergence observations.
Notes: Exposed to the headless runner's regression command.

Capability: Records nonlinear convergence and residual threshold policies and observations (active-set count, free-DOF force/moment, work, energy, displacement/reaction deltas) for fixture sets.
Notes: The release-scope convergence policy record is referenced by no test or code; the single-support displacement observation record is not loaded by the Python test.

Capability: Regression-tests the product linear static preview in sparse and dense modes on an invented cantilever against independently frozen expectations, with negative controls.
Notes: Test-only crate with no other caller; reached through Cargo discovery under validation/benchmarks by the sweep and readiness tools.

Capability: Records the sparse solver suitability and pivot-conditioning threshold policies and their observation set on invented generated grids.
Notes: Observation produced by the solver performance harness; scoped to the generated-grid set only.

Capability: Records the observation promoting sparse solving to the interactive default and the policy governing dense cross-check scrutiny.
Notes: Produced by a performance-harness example; bounded to its observation set.

Capability: Documents hand calculations and provenance for the invented mechanics benchmark fixtures, including fixture unit basis.
Notes: The mechanics crate embeds the README and cites each note path from fixture provenance.

Capability: Documents hand calculations for the nonlinear support fixtures: state transitions, gaps, lift-off, friction, multi-support acceptance and convergence observations.
Documents hand calculations for the stress recovery fixtures (axial, bending, torsion, pressure, range, integrated and wall-tolerance cases).
Notes: The generated/ subfolder note is rendered from the formal witness and must not be hand-edited.

Capability: Validates formal calculation witnesses against a JSON schema, evaluates their expressions with dimensional checking, renders Markdown and MathML, and detects stale renderings.
Notes: Deliberately independent of production solver and stress code.

Capability: Provides the pilot section-property stress calculation witness with its experimental content dictionary and deterministic Markdown and MathML renderings.
Notes: Only one witness exists; the format is a pilot.

Capability: Provides generated invented request inputs and captured runner outputs for the headless export-results command across success, missing payload, binding mismatch and blocked producer.
Notes: The captured output files are not read by tests; the intent-required output has no matching input file.

Capability: Provides generated invented inputs and captured runner outputs for benchmark and regression commands bound to the benchmark suites, including missing-payload cases.
Notes: Static reproduction evidence; no test or code reads these files.

Capability: Provides generated invented inputs and captured outputs for the headless runner command line (solve, validation blocking, benchmark stub) and a headless preview run.
Notes: Static reproduction evidence; no test or code reads these files. The benchmark stub output predates the suite-bound benchmark outputs and may be stale.

Capability: Declares historical path-role overrides and control-path exceptions, with hashes and reasons, for the repository path-anchor portability validator.
Notes: Consumed by a repository-root validator that globs every project's policy file; entries point into governance run records.
